issues.description: setuptools<82 pin leaks from CI workaround into core/setup.py runtime install_requires.
issues.detail: The cap exists because mmcv's build breaks on setuptools>=82 with pkg_resources removed. Putting that cap into core/setup.py's hyperopt extras forces every downstream user of autogluon.core[ray] to take an outdated setuptools forever, for a transitive build-time issue they will never hit. Move it out of runtime deps; keep it in CI scripts only.

issues.description: mmdet bumped 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0 alongside the build fix with no stated justification.
issues.detail: The PR is titled as a CI fix for mmengine, but it also moves mmdet a minor version. If mmdet 3.3.0 is required by mmengine 0.10.7 or mmcv 2.1.0, say so in the diff or commit message. Otherwise split it — two independent changes braided into one rollback unit.

issues.description: setuptools<82 pinned in three places with no shared source of truth.
issues.detail: The cap now appears in env_setup.sh, setup_mmcv.sh, and core/setup.py. When upstream mmcv issue 3325 resolves, a future maintainer must find and revert three separated sites, which guarantees a partial revert. Centralize the constraint to one named place that the call sites reference.

issues.description: FIXME comments name the upstream issue but no observable revert criterion.
issues.detail: Both FIXMEs point at open-mmlab/mmcv#3325 and say 'remove cap once fixed.' There is no internal owner, no concrete revert condition (e.g., mmcv >= X.Y published with setuptools>=82-compatible build), and no test that fails once the cap can be lifted. Without that, this pin will outlive its cause.

issues.description: mmengine pin swap from git SHA to 0.10.7 wheel without recording why.
issues.detail: The prior code pinned a specific git SHA with the comment 'fix for torch 2.5.' The replacement jumps to 0.10.7 PyPI release with no note confirming that wheel contains the torch-2.5 fix the SHA was added for. A one-line comment would let the next reader verify regression risk without git archaeology.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a pragmatic CI fix for the setuptools>=82 / pkg_resources removal that breaks mmcv's build, with the right mechanism (cap setuptools, switch mmengine off a git SHA onto a PyPI release). The dominant complaint, raised independently by all three reviewers, is scope leakage: the setuptools<82 cap propagates into core/setup.py's runtime install_requires, forcing a CI workaround onto every downstream user of autogluon.core. Secondary concern shared by the panel is the unjustified mmdet 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0 bump braided into a fix PR. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — land the CI script changes, pull the runtime pin out of core, justify or split the mmdet bump, and add concrete revert criteria to the FIXMEs.
